name: take me to the lakes where all the poets went to die
source:
Sometimes you come back to Lake Dioscuri where Elizabeth Flanagan drowned. You hated her. You loved her.

You could never be her.

[From [url=https://ednaarel.itch.io/the-lakes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有時，你會回到狄俄斯庫里湖。伊麗莎白．弗拉納根就是在那裡溺死的。你恨她。你愛她。

你永遠成不了她。

［取自[url=https://ednaarel.itch.io/the-lakes]Itch.io[/url]］
